purpose: Active Team contract for source-neutral relational mapping candidates and Protocol read/write handoff.

neutral_candidate.identity: item_id plus table_mapping_id, join_mapping_id, enum_meaning_id or metric_id; schema version and labels do not create identities

unified_candidate.identity: Candidate item identity and full item digest remain neutral; approval projection carries the complete translated payload.

semantic_definition.rule: Unknown, not applicable and conflicting meanings remain explicit; schema names and sample values do not establish business meaning.

references.current_candidate: Recursively use {definition_ref: item_id}; unresolved or platform-shaped references are repairable Protocol conflicts.
references.existing_resource: Use {existing_resource_ref: {semantic_id, resource_kind}} only with the active R4.0-010 governed resource binding receipt. The R2.3-003 existing_entity_ref contract is not a mapping binding.
references.database_boundary: Schema and representative samples locate physical tables/columns. Business rows, DSNs, credentials, SQL execution and conversion scripts remain external.

protocol_contract.host_configuration: Protocol reads semantic_base_iri from the injected mechanical platform context and passes it to translate_candidate_to_batches; it is never authored in the neutral candidate.
protocol_contract.active_binding_tool: build_unified_resource_binding_receipt accepts an unmodified governed read envelope plus selected project_id, ontology_id and workspace_version scope, then binds actual resource_kind, semantic_id and resource_iri.
protocol_contract.identity: Receipt and read binding always carries resource_kind and resource_iri; mapping resources are never coerced to entity.
protocol_contract.readback: Use governed resource-kind reads and the existing resource-specific mapping/metric projections. Do not use asserted_data statements as a mapping completeness shortcut.
protocol_contract.evidence: No new Evidence or lineage artifact is required; existing Batch, Attempt, dry-run/apply, receipt and recovery records remain authoritative.
